_note: Short descriptions for the Claude.ai upload path, which caps description at 200 characters. Source of truth for full descriptions remains each skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

descriptions.a11y-contract-testing: Use when accessibility regressions slip past review: unnamed dialogs, wrong roles on wrappers, menus or tabs losing ARIA state, modals invisible to getByRole. Locks roles, names, focus, and state.
descriptions.async-effect-race-contracts: Use when raw async effects race or leak: an older fetch result overwrites a newer one, cleanup missing after unmount, StrictMode double-setup, stale closures, effects looping on unstable deps.
descriptions.bff-proxy-security-contracts: Use when reviewing frontend-owned server proxy code (Next.js Route Handlers, Remix actions, /api/proxy gateways) for client-selected-target SSRF, path and method allowlists, multipart upload budgets.
descriptions.browser-page-lifecycle-bfcache-contracts: Use when Back/Forward restores a stale half-alive page: logged-out data reappears, a spinner or socket stays paused, analytics double-count, or unload/beforeunload blocks back-forward cache.
descriptions.browser-storage-durability-contracts: Use when browser-local data reported saved disappears: IndexedDB upgrade hangs behind another tab, TransactionInactiveError, QuotaExceededError or eviction, navigator.storage.persist() misread.
descriptions.cjk-text-and-input: Use when Korean, Japanese, or Chinese text breaks mid-word, IME composition breaks a controlled input, Enter fires mid-composition, keyCode 229 duplicates keydown, or length miscounts Hangul.
descriptions.client-error-observability-contracts: Use when frontend error capture misbehaves: production shows only Script error, unhandled rejections vanish, minified stacks cannot be symbolicated, one bug fragments, or PII leaves the browser.
descriptions.component-extraction-judgment: Use when deciding whether to extract a shared component: near-duplicate cards, rows, or banners, boolean-prop variant sprawl, wrapper-only components, duplicated hooks, copy-pasted AI-generated UI.
descriptions.constraint-validation-contracts: Use when native HTML form validation misfires: fields red on page load (:invalid vs :user-invalid), setCustomValidity left set so submit is blocked, checkValidity vs reportValidity vs novalidate.
descriptions.contenteditable-selection-contracts: Use when a contenteditable or rich-text host loses or jumps the caret, reverses a selection, drops edits, breaks undo/redo, pastes at the wrong range, or corrupts an active IME composition.
descriptions.core-web-vitals-performance-contracts: Use when Core Web Vitals regress and the cause must be attributed: LCP discovered late or blocked, CLS from unreserved media or injected UI, INP delayed by long tasks, slow TTFB gating the page.
descriptions.css-transition-animation-contracts: Use when enter/exit transitions break: exit animation cut off, entry never plays on first open, ::backdrop does not fade, or unmount and scroll-unlock hang because transitionend never fired.
descriptions.datetime-correctness: Use when timezone, DST, or date-only parsing is wrong: new Date("2026-06-14") printing the previous day, datetime-local stored with no zone, adding 24h across DST, toLocaleString in the server zone.
descriptions.deeplink-hydration: Use when deep links into an SPA lose query params or land on the wrong screen: Next.js router.query empty on first render, redirects firing before router.isReady, login bounce losing returnTo.
descriptions.design-to-code-fidelity: Use when rendered UI does not match the design reference: wrong fill or stroke, missing section background, off spacing or radius, misplaced CTA, clipped badge, copy drift. Produces a graded diff.
descriptions.download-export-safety: Use when client-side export or copy flows misbehave: CSV and Excel downloads, blob downloads, URL.createObjectURL lifecycle, navigator.clipboard writes, filenames, user-controlled spreadsheet cells.
descriptions.file-ingest-contracts: Use when bringing files into the page breaks: drop-zone flicker from dragenter/leave counting, a dropped file navigates the page away, folder drop yields nothing, accept trusted over magic bytes.
descriptions.frontend-auth-flow-contracts: Use when implementing or reviewing login, signup, password reset, email verification, one-time codes, passkeys and WebAuthn, auth callbacks and returnTo, autofill, or enumeration-safe errors.
descriptions.frontend-data-fetching-cache-contracts: Use when client-side reads go stale against TanStack Query, SWR, RTK Query, or Apollo: mutations invalidate the wrong key, unstable keys collide, waterfalls, refetch storms, unbounded pagination.
descriptions.frontend-report-triage: Use when a vague frontend bug report, QA note, screenshot, or support ticket must be ranked across runtime, browser, data, accessibility, security, performance, and design failure classes first.
descriptions.frontend-security-baseline: Use when running a client-side security pass before shipping: unsafe HTML sinks, sanitizer misuse, raw-HTML escape hatches, CSP host-allowlist gaps, JWT in localStorage, SameSite, open redirects.
descriptions.history-scroll-restoration-contracts: Use when SPA Back/Forward restores the wrong scroll position: page jumps to the top, restores before async content adds height, jumps a second time after layout, loses a nested scroll container.
descriptions.i18n-copy-and-layout: Use when shipping UI copy in more than one language: text overflowing buttons after translation, long German compounds, count === 1 plurals breaking in Russian or Arabic, concatenation, no RTL.
descriptions.iframe-embed-contracts: Use when an iframe or embedded widget fails: blank frame from frame-ancestors, postMessage wildcard targetOrigin with no origin check, lost first READY message, resize loops, sandbox blocking forms.
descriptions.js-form-validation-contracts: Use when react-hook-form, Formik, vee-validate, or a zod/yup resolver misfires: errors shown before a field is touched, error persists after correction, submit stuck on isValid, server 409 lost.
descriptions.large-list-data-grid-contracts: Use when a virtualized list or data grid breaks at windowing seams: variable-height measurement jumps scroll, overscan blanks rows, find-in-page misses unmounted rows, sticky regions drift.
descriptions.media-capture-device-contracts: Use when getUserMedia camera or microphone capture stays blocked after denial, fails when a device is unplugged or switched, opens the same device twice, or leaves the camera light on after unmount.
descriptions.money-and-precision-contracts: Use when money arithmetic is off by a fraction of a penny: totals showing 0.30000000000000004, line items not reconciling, (1.005).toFixed(2) giving 1.00, float prices, parseFloat mangling 1.234,56.
descriptions.optimistic-update-rollback-contracts: Use when an optimistic update goes wrong: it never rolls back on failure, a created row appears twice, the item flickers and reverts, or a temp client id is never swapped for the real server id.
descriptions.overlay-focus-scroll-contracts: Use when a modal, dialog, drawer, popover, or command palette regresses focus trap or restoration, background inert and aria-hidden, ESC or backdrop dismissal, nested stacks, or body scroll-lock.
descriptions.payment-page-client-security: Use when reviewing checkout pages for PAN or CVV in the DOM, state, logs, analytics, or URLs, Stripe and Adyen hosted fields, payment-page script inventory, and PCI DSS 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 evidence.
descriptions.pointer-gesture-contracts: Use when a drag, resize handle, slider, canvas tool, or swipe stops outside its hit area, stays active after release, misses pointercancel, loses pen input, or blocks pan and zoom via touch-action.
descriptions.pwa-offline-cache-contracts: Use when a service worker serves the wrong bytes: a waiting worker leaves users on an old build, stale HTML references purged chunks, one failed cache.addAll aborts install, no offline fallback.
descriptions.realtime-transport-contracts: Use when a WebSocket or SSE client misbehaves across a drop: reconnect storms with no jitter, socket OPEN but dead on close code 1006, events duplicated without Last-Event-ID, bufferedAmount climbing.
descriptions.resize-observer-layout-contracts: Use when ResizeObserver UI flickers, grows forever, throws "ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications", measures the wrong box, or keeps observing unmounted elements.
descriptions.responsive-image-contracts: Use when responsive image markup ships the wrong file: srcset width descriptors without accurate sizes, descriptors off from intrinsic widths, LCP image lazy or low priority, img missing dimensions.
descriptions.semantic-markup-contracts: Use when markup structure is wrong: clickable divs that should be buttons, links used as buttons, broken heading and landmark hierarchy, unassociated form labels, ARIA piled on top of native HTML.
descriptions.ssr-hydration-mismatch: Use when server HTML and the client first render diverge: React "Hydration failed" or "text content did not match", silent client re-render, output depending on Date.now() or typeof window.
descriptions.user-activation-contracts: Use when a gesture-gated API works from a direct click but fails after await: window.open returns null, an OAuth popup is blocked, clipboard, share, file picker, or fullscreen throws NotAllowedError.
descriptions.view-transitions-contracts: Use when a View Transitions API animation aborts or captures the wrong state: duplicate view-transition-name, unpainted image state, React update outside startTransition, no reduced-motion.
descriptions.webview-bridge-pages: Use when building web pages inside a native app WebView: postMessage-to-native bridge, first READY message missed on cold start, Android hardware back, blank screen after renderer death.
